## Context

README lists `.github/workflows/validate.yml` and `build-index.yml` (only `.forkmesh/blt-cve--build-index.yml` exists; validation runs through `scripts/ci/tests.tsv`), links `owasp.org/www-project-buglogging-tool/` (typo), and CONTRIBUTING clones from GitHub.

## What to do

1. Fix the workflow references, the OWASP link (`www-project-bug-logging-tool`) and the clone steps.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Every referenced file exists
- [ ] OWASP link resolves
- [ ] Clone steps work

## How to test locally

```bash
scripts/ci/test.sh blt-cve
```
